title: 第1093章 天武不孤第1092章 全力备战
lines: “异族入侵了我们的家乡。”
姬花扬起头，与剑无名同样黑色的眼带，在风中飘舞。
“族长大人在星河战场与数倍于己的敌人厮杀，迄今未归，胜负难料，生死不明。暗月大人和绔屈、夜笙箫两位护法于星空之外与敌人的天境强者交手。”
“而如今敌人入侵了神光大陆，我天武域已经到了生死存亡之际。神界之上，北起葬天境，南至太虚境；东起星罗境，西至炽血境，所有的势力均是前往前线。”
姬花的声音有些嘶哑，“他们将我们留在这里，是做了最后的打算，一旦天武兵败，我们这些人便是为天武域孕育火种的人！”
“可是，天武的男儿都战死在了沙场，我们就算还活着，就算我们以后孕育了子嗣，他们还能算我我天武域的种吗？！”
姬花的声音悲切而苍凉。
姬花四女长剑同时出鞘，剑意冲天而起，剑意当中带着决绝之意。
“在此，我等四姐妹号召，与我等之志，同心之姐妹共赴族难，此志若死，方休！”
“我等愿共赴族难！此志，若死方休！”
“此志！若死方休！”
“姐妹们！出发！”
姬花四女从台上一跃而下，向着回天武大陆的传送阵而去，身后则是一众实力不一的女子，她们有的芳华二八，实力只有天武境，也有尊者境和帝者境。
至此，天武域可谓真正的若败，便是灭种之战！
此刻的谷清歌站立于虚空当中，手中拿着指挥令牌，这一次进攻神光大陆的总指挥正是他。
上次重伤之后，南知意便是将其派来了天武域。当然之所以他们敢公然进攻天武域，也是得到了上界的首肯。
杜君剑前去谈合作，张道升等人便是将消息发出了出去，几日的等待之后，终于等来了上界的回复，只有一个字：可。
“父亲，老祖那里有消息了。”苏离悄然来到苏牧的身边。
“老祖怎么说？”苏牧表面不动声色，心中却是极为紧张。
“老祖说，这次天元的水太深了，他们无法直接插手这里的事情，但是若是真的不可为的话，老祖让我们从通道直接去他那里，至于关系他已经打点好了。”苏离轻声道
听到此话，苏牧微微松了口气，他苏家看来是高枕无忧了。
谷清歌看了一眼挡在他正前方的夜笙箫，轻笑道：“你可是为数不多的高阶天境强者，就这样守在这里，就不怕他们那里败了？”
夜笙箫看着谷清歌依旧有些苍白的脸色，接着便是摸了一把额头的上的血，然后放在眼前看了看，他的额头上有一道深可见骨的伤口，伤口边缘的力量依旧在阻止着伤口的愈合。
他低头从储物戒指当中拿出了一个玉瓶，将其中的丹药倒入掌心当中，随手丢掉玉瓶，将药丸捏成粉末，就这样当着谷清歌的面涂抹到额头的伤口处，伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合。
“哦，不好意思，让你久等了。”夜笙箫一本正经的道。
夜笙箫抠了抠鼻孔，然后对着谷清歌的方向一弹。
谷清歌的眼中杀机闪烁。
“我看你脸色苍白，不会是在星河战场当中被萧羽那个小子给揍了吧？”
夜笙箫的话让谷清歌差点破防。
content_en:
"Aliens invaded our hometown."
Ji Hua raised her head, the same black eyebands as Jian Wuming fluttering in the wind.
"The patriarch of the clan fought against an enemy several times his own on the battlefield of the Galaxy. He has not returned yet. The outcome is unpredictable, and life and death are unknown. Lord Dark Moon and the two protectors Dian Qu and Ye Shengxiao fought against the enemy's powerful heavenly warriors outside the starry sky."
"Now that the enemy has invaded the Shenguang Continent, our Tianwu Territory has reached the point of life and death. Above the God Realm, starting from Burial Heaven Realm in the north, to Taixu Realm in the south; from Xingluo Realm in the east, to Blazing Blood Realm in the west, all forces are heading to the front line."
Ji Hua's voice was a little hoarse, "They left us here as a last resort. Once the Tianwu army is defeated, we are the ones who will breed fire for the Tianwu domain!"
"However, all the men of Tianwu died on the battlefield. Even if we are still alive, even if we give birth to children in the future, can they still be regarded as my descendants of Tianwu Domain?!"
Ji Hua's voice was sad and desolate.
"Qiang!"
The swords of the four girls of Ji Hua were unsheathed at the same time, and their sword intent soared into the sky, with a sense of determination in their sword intent.
"Here, we, the four sisters, are calling for us to go to the disaster of our clan with our sisters who have the same ambition and the same heart. This ambition will only end if we die!"
"We are willing to fight against our family's calamity together! This ambition will only end if we die!"
"This ambition! It will only happen if you die!"
"Sisters! Let's go!"
The four girls Ji Hua jumped off the stage and headed towards the teleportation formation back to Tianwu Continent. Behind them were a group of women with different strengths. Some of them were young and young, but their strength was only at Tianwu realm, as well as at Venerable realm and Emperor realm.
At this point, it can be said that if the Tianwu Domain is defeated, it will be a battle of annihilation!
At this moment, Gu Qingge was standing in the void, holding a command token in his hand. He was the commander-in-chief of the attack on Shenguang Continent this time.
After he was seriously injured last time, Nan Zhiyi sent him to Tianwu Territory. Of course, the reason why they dared to openly attack the Tianwu Territory was because they had the approval of the upper realm.
Du Junjian went to discuss cooperation, and Zhang Daosheng and others sent out the news. After several days of waiting, they finally received a reply from the upper realm, which contained only one word: Yes.
"Father, there is news from our ancestors." Su Li quietly came to Su Mu's side.
"What did the ancestor say?" Su Mu looked calm on the surface, but was extremely nervous in his heart.
"Ancestor said that the water in Tianyuan is too deep this time and they can't directly intervene in the affairs here. But if it is really impossible, Ancestor will let us go directly to him from the passage. As for the relationship, he has already taken care of it." Su Li said softly.
Hearing this, Su Mu breathed a sigh of relief. The Su family seemed to be at ease.
Gu Qingge glanced at Ye Shengxiao, who was standing in front of him, and chuckled: "You are one of the few high-level heavenly experts. If you just stay here like this, aren't you afraid that they will be defeated?"
Ye Shengxiao looked at Gu Qingge's still pale face, then touched a handful of blood on his forehead, and then looked at it in front of his eyes. There was a deep wound on his forehead, and the force at the edge of the wound was still preventing the wound from healing.
He lowered his head and took out a jade bottle from the storage ring, poured the elixir in it into the palm of his hand, threw away the jade bottle, crushed the pills into powder, and applied it to the wound on his forehead in front of Gu Qingge. The wound healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Oh, I'm sorry to keep you waiting." Ye Shengxiao said seriously.
Ye Shengxiao picked her nostrils and then flicked in Gu Qingge's direction.
Gu Qingge's eyes flashed with murderous intent.
"I see that your face is pale. Could it be that you were beaten by that boy Xiao Yu in the Galaxy Battlefield?"
Ye Shengxiao's words almost broke Gu Qingge's defense.
